survey: A folding camp/director's chair seen in three-quarter view from the front-left and moderately above, standing on a flat floor in front of a studio backdrop. The chair's depth runs down and to the right toward the viewer. The left and right sides each have a pair of armrests and back posts joined by a crossed (X) leg frame. Each X has a round pivot rivet, and all four feet end in grey caps on the floor. The two back posts hold a green fabric backrest with grey top caps. It faces the same way as the seat's front edge and sits on the same slight upward slope to the right as the lines of feet. The green fabric seat hangs between a left and a right side rail. Its front bar ends in cylinder caps beside the front uprights, and the seat top is seen from above, which matches the visible tops of the armrests and the post caps. The padded armrests run from the back posts forward and down-right to the front uprights, the same depth direction as the side X frames. The four feet form a consistent parallelogram on the floor. The front and back foot lines are parallel, and so are the two side lines. The feet and the cast shadow meet the floor at its drawn angle. The line where the wall meets the floor is a backdrop seam, not the eye level, so seeing the seat from above does not contradict it.
